title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
abstract: arXiv:2610.36956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand

translated_title: 为十三世纪而挖掘十九世纪：借助传统教皇法令摘要与古籍整理版本实现卷册规模的强制对齐与手写文本识别自举
translated_abstract: 教皇洪诺留三世卷册的手写文本识别（HTR）依赖于现代专家转录，而这些转录仅存在于Reg. Vat. 9在位第1-2年的部分。对于其余卷册，十九世纪的学术成果提供了Pressutti编纂的教皇法令摘要及部分刊布文本。在两种文本层并存的对开页1-203上，我们在首先据此对现代转录进行校核之后，测量了这一传统文本层所能贡献的价值，并发现其在三个层级上呈现分工。在正字法层级上，直接使用刊布文本对识别器进行在位第二年适应至多是中性的，且在不采用重放机制时甚至有害；而将其投射为教廷拼写并重放现代源文本行，则使其成为零标注适应目标：汇总全部134个第二年页面，词错误率（WER）下降1.50个百分点（95%置信区间为-1.84至-1.15），缩小了与理想参照之间差距的33%；拼写方式在年份分界处发生变化，无论归因于抄写员还是转录者，而手迹……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本研究利用十九世纪Pressutti教皇法令摘要等传统学术资源，通过“投射至教廷拼写并重放现代源文本行”的方法实现零标注的手写文本识别适应，使教皇洪诺留三世卷册第二年页面的词错误率下降1.50个百分点、缩小33%与理想参照的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that nineteenth-century Pressutti regesta and antiquarian editions can bootstrap HTR for Pope Honorius III's registers: projecting legacy editions onto curial spelling while replaying modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets, reducing WER by 1.50 points and closing 33% of the gap to an oracle.
